axis: A5 (E39a pre-registered): 실제 예약을 하는가 -- declared / enforced / 해당 없음
reason: no reservation call appears in any source file, so the budget is a number compared against a contract, not a reservation of physical memory

reservation_calls_looked_for.MAP_POPULATE: mmap flag that prefaults (and with MAP_LOCKED, reserves) pages
reservation_calls_looked_for.MAP_LOCKED: mmap flag that locks the mapping
reservation_calls_looked_for.CFE_ES_PoolCreate: creates a cFE memory pool, i.e. carves out a reserved region
reservation_calls_looked_for.CFE_ES_GetPoolBuf: allocates from a cFE reserved pool

waived.why: line marked as a fixture that feeds this scanner (D77)

why_waivers_are_line_level: a line carrying the marker 'budget-provenance: test-fixture' feeds this scanner instead of using the call. Excluding a whole file would hide a real call added to it later, so the waiver is one line wide and is copied verbatim here (D77).

scan_scope.why_sources_only: logs are not code. While planning E44 an audit reported 'CFE_TBL used 0 times' and a direct grep returned 15 hits -- all fifteen in cFS boot logs, none in source.

never_promotes: a hit downgrades to `unknown`; it never yields `enforced`, because a call existing is not that call reserving this budget (E28/D52).
